info.name: VTex Anti-fraud Provider Account Sales Channel Mapping API
VTex Get Sales Channel Mapping Data

params.name: accountName
params.description: Name of the VTEX account that belongs to the marketplace. The notification will be posted into this account.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment to use. Used as part of the URL.

params.name: an
params.description: Marketplace's account name, the same one inputted on the endpoint's path.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: A string that identifies the seller in the marketplace. This ID must be created by the marketplace and informed to the seller before the integration is built.

items.docs: Retrieves information about the mapping between marketplace's sales channels and a specific seller.

items.docs: This endpoint allows the marketplace to map its sales channels with a seller's [affiliate](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/configuring-affiliates--tutorials_187). The seller can have multiple sales channels associated with the same marketplace, by creating different affiliates. The mapping enables the seller to segment catalog, prices, inventory, logistics, and payments in the marketplace.
